_note: EV charging economics for HELIO Flow. The displacement assumption is honestly labelled speculative: charged kWh are assumed to enable EV-km that replace ICE car-km in the district.

ev_kwh_per_km.label: measured
ev_kwh_per_km.source: LTA EV Guide 2024: 16 kWh/100km official SG car average; cross-checked vs Thai real-world urban BEV 0.160 kWh/km (Achariyaviriya 2023, 26-31°C, A/C on)

utilization.label: measured
utilization.source: MOT parliamentary reply 7 May 2026: ~20% avg utilisation at HDB carparks (9% JTC-managed). Directly matches this model's 20%.

kwh_per_kw_year.label: measured
kwh_per_kw_year.source: 1 kW x 8,760 h x 20% utilisation (MOT-verified HDB rate)

displacement.label: speculative
displacement.source: Fraction of charged kWh that enable EV-km actually REPLACING ICE car-km (vs charging that would have happened elsewhere). Base 50%; see displacement_scenarios.

displacement_scenarios.label: speculative
displacement_scenarios.source: Additionality is NOT directly measured in SG (deep-research 2026) — scenario band, not a forecast. Upper case anchored to EU proxy: home-charging-less urban EV owners draw ~70% of energy from public overnight charging (ACEA/McKinsey). At conservative, report as 'EV-km enabled potential'.

solar_paired_ci_factor.label: calibrated proxy
solar_paired_ci_factor.source: Solar-first charging shifts sessions into the midday solar window (IEA PVPS T17-02 dispatch priority)

charger_capex_per_port_usd.label: calibrated proxy
charger_capex_per_port_usd.source: 22 kW AC public charger installed cost
